objective: At the Salt Office Berec Sund rules that Kethra's line lapses when the book closes at noon on the last tally-day, third season unlodged, and reads Sev Marrow the old inquiry that put her off the Pan: eleven dead, and a guide who came in alone off the line on a bearing and a count of paces she has never given up.
hook: the only thing to come off the Pan this season is a child sitting against the Office wall with Kethra's seal unbroken on a cord, and no voice to say what is in it.

objective: Sev hires Oduin Reck and his two camels at half what the season is worth, finds the line's standing board not posted this season by an order nobody will own, and hears from him why the landing will not say the name Kethra: a quarter of the dock hands walked in off the Pan out of it two seasons ago and were entered as lapsed.
hook: he says he is retained by the Office for the season already, and does not say what for.

objective: Cairn Nine's cistern is found drawn out to the floor with its seal left off, which gives the party nothing and turns a supplied crossing into one that can no longer be turned back from: what is on the camels will carry them to Kethra or back to Cairn Four but not both, and Sev goes on instead of back.
hook: Tallow writes eleven days in the salt beside the open shaft, which is how long ago she drank from this cistern on her way out alone, and rubs the number out before Oduin has finished reading it.

objective: The party reaches Kethra at first light and finds forty houses barred on the outside and left in order, the well gone to brine, and the map-keeper dead at the tally-house table of the water he went on drinking after Tallow stopped, with the season's ledger open at the page where he swore her apprentice-keeper and nothing written under it.
hook: Sev asks Tallow where the tally is, and Tallow puts her hand flat on the case round her neck.

objective: Tallow breaks Kethra's seal in front of them to show the case is empty, which cannot be undone and voids it as a lodgement under r5, so the errand stops being the carriage of a document and turns into the carriage of the only person holding the count: the child who has just come home must recross the Pan instead of staying in it.
hook: she writes on the table that the keeper sent the case out empty because the last two tallies never reached the lectern, and the case was the thing he meant them to take.

objective: The party loads Kethra's last sealed cistern, which is water enough to reach Cairn Four and not a swallow past it, and goes back on to the crust; Tallow writes out the first draws of the count, which are draws Sund's own seals say were never made, and Oduin gives up the money the Office paid him to be slow.
hook: he asks Tallow to write his name in the book beside the count, and drops the coin into her can to seal it.

objective: On the long stage past a dry Cairn Nine the count runs out in the dark exactly where Tallow says it must, no cairn stands at it, and she will not take back a number she is certain of.
hook: the crust begins to tick under them, which is the cold going out of it.

objective: First light takes nothing anywhere on the horizon where Cairn Four's whitewash should take it first, and Sev stops steering by the line altogether: she takes the party off it on purpose, on the bearing she came in on eleven years ago, to cross-fix the buried slab from the only mark left out there, so that her eleven dead turn from the thing she will not speak about into the thing the party's water is measured from, and the crust will not carry them back to the line behind them.
hook: she paces the bearing back off the wreck of her own caravan, and the count ends on a slab with Cairn Four's stamp still under the salt on it.

objective: At the slab they open Cairn Four's cistern, and because the crust will not carry a loaded animal once the sun is up Oduin cuts his two camels loose to find their own way in, so that the three of them walk the short leg to Dray Landing on foot through softening crust and come up the ramp past the dock hands who walked in off the Pan out of Kethra two seasons ago, an hour short of noon.
hook: the Kethra nail on the wall behind the lectern is empty, and the only paper on the board under it is an order striking Cairn Four from the line for repair, dated the night they went out.

objective: Sund refuses the lodgement on two articles - a case broken off the lectern is void, and a tally is given by the town's keeper, who has no voice - and Tallow answers both by writing Kethra's count into the book in her own hand, a count the seals on Sund's own nails cannot match; he is struck off under the article he was quoting, and Sev signs beneath the count and puts the eleven names in with her own and Oduin's.
hook: Sev takes the line itself as its keeper, and goes out on to the Pan in the cold to build Cairn Four up again.
